UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with German learning level, streak, daily goal and total XP

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user matching auth uid

dailyGoal.description: Target daily study goal in lessons or minutes

createdDate.description: ISO timestamp when the user account was created

Lesson.title: Lesson
Lesson.description: Curriculum lesson from A1 to B2 German

title.description: Lesson title in English and German

germanLevel.description: CEFR proficiency level required for this lesson

category.description: Subject category (e.g. Greetings, Housing, Work, Travel)

description.description: Short summary of what this lesson teaches

lessonContent.description: Full pedagogical content, dialogue, or grammar breakdown

lessonOrder.description: Sequential display order within the level

Vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
Vocabulary.description: German vocabulary entry with pronunciation and example sentence

vocabularyId.description: Unique identifier of the vocabulary word

germanWord.description: German word with grammatical article if applicable

exampleSentence.description: Example German sentence demonstrating practical usage

germanLevel.description: CEFR proficiency level (A1, A2, B1, B2)

category.description: Topic category (e.g. Everyday, Housing, Bank, Health, Work, Food)

Quiz.title: Quiz
Quiz.description: Interactive German practice quiz with questions and correct answers

germanLevel.description: CEFR proficiency level for the quiz

questions.description: JSON serialized or structured list of quiz questions with multiple-choice options

correctAnswers.description: JSON serialized or structured array of correct answer indices or answers

category.description: Quiz topic category (e.g. Articles, Grammar Cases, Vocabulary, Etiquette)

UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Private learning progress tracking for a specific user and lesson

lessonId.description: ID of the lesson being tracked

quizScore.description: Percentage score earned on the lesson quiz

vocabularyLearned.description: Count or list of vocabulary items mastered in this lesson

xpEarned.description: Experience points earned from this lesson

lastActivity.description: Timestamp of the user's latest interaction with this lesson

DailyGoal.title: DailyGoal
DailyGoal.description: Private daily learning targets and completion records for a user

dailyTarget.description: Daily study target (e.g. lessons or minutes)

/lessons/{lessonId}.description: Shared educational lessons from A1 to B2

/vocabulary/{vocabularyId}.description: Shared vocabulary bank across CEFR levels

/users/{userId}/progress/{lessonId}.description: Private user progress records for each lesson

/users/{userId}/dailyGoals/{date}.description: Private daily goals tracking for each user by date
